title: ExDark low-light / night
description: 160 low-light photos (very low light to twilight) from the ExDark test split, 6.7 MB (6689717 bytes) in total. Images were resized (stretched) to 640x640 by the Roboflow YOLO export, so resolution is uniform (res:sd) and aspect ratios are distorted. Scored labels: person (ExDark 'People'), bicycle, car, motorbike, bus, dog, cat; boat/bottle/chair/cup/diningtable boxes are ignore regions. Selection favours outdoor street, people, vehicle and animal scenes.
